name: pokedex-monorepo
description: Pokedex application with Next.js frontend and NestJS backend

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run start:dev --prefix server" --names "CLIENT,SERVER" --prefix-colors "blue,green"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
